comment: The three frequency selectors each carry an Off position that the manual omits, and Off is the default, so a new module has only the input gain, the 10kHz shelf and the output level doing anything (SeventiesEQ.cpp:219-228). The input gain is 1 + 4 * knob (SeventiesEQ.cpp:325) while its tooltip is configured as a plain 5x multiplier of the knob, so the two agree only from the default position upwards and the tooltip reads 0x where the gain is really 1x. The high shelf is always in circuit; its frequency is fixed at 10kHz in the code and cannot be changed.
